era: 日本幕末至明治启蒙与文明转型时代 / Bakumatsu-to-Meiji Enlightenment & Civilizational Transformation Era (1835-1901)
school: 启蒙思想/教育实践/言论产业 / Enlightenment Thought / Educational Practice / Discourse as Industry
historical_significance: 日本明治启蒙思想的旗手，庆应义塾创立者、《时事新报》创办人。出身中津藩下级武士，三度随幕府使节出访欧美，率先把西方文明的『内在逻辑』而非器物表层引介到日本（《西洋事情》发行量逾百万）。核心贡献：以『实学』取代虚学、把学问定义为可验证的实用知识；以『一身独立而后一国独立』把个人独立设定为国家富强的逻辑起点；以《文明论之概略》把文明划为『外形的精神与内在的精神』并主张『一人之为而后众人为之』的士风塑造论；以《脱亚论》完成对东亚国际秩序的战略切割；以『时务人士』论把知识分子定位为政府的监督者与国民的向导而非官吏候补。他是一个把文明当作物候、把言论当作产业、把独立当作终身修行的启蒙工程师。
unique_thinking: 以实学优先为认识论入口、以一身独立为价值基点、以文明内外两轴与阶段位差为分析框架、以士风塑造与言论产业化为执行路径、以跨文明取景与战略切割为定位手段的完整启蒙工程体系。其思维特质在于：把文明当作可测量、可分期、可移植的物候系统——先诊断一国文明所处的阶段位差，再决定学什么（内在精神而非器物表层）、谁来学（一人为之而后众人为之）、如何持续供给（把言论办成产业、把知识普及做成出版事业）；并始终以『一身独立而后一国独立』把宏大工程锚定在个体尊严的最小单元上。
key_concepts: 一人之为而后众人为之

cross_references.relation_type: 启蒙的双重路径：公开运用理性的公开性 vs 实学与个体独立的启蒙工程
cross_references.description_zh: 康德在《什么是启蒙》中以'公开运用理性的自由'与'敢于运用自己的理智'定义启蒙（M-KD 系列）；福泽以《劝学篇》'天不造人上人'把同一命题落到教育实践与国民动员（M-FYJ-001/M-FYJ-002）。两人共享同一启蒙内核：心智的成熟不能靠权威代劳。差异在于康德把启蒙锚定在理性的先验条件与公共性原则，福泽把启蒙锚定在实学的可验证性与一身为本的独立修行——前者为启蒙立法，后者把启蒙办成学塾与报纸。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 康德档案（H-KD-001）未来修订时可在'什么是启蒙'处补一条指向 H-FYJ-001 的跨引用（实学启蒙的明治版本）。

cross_references.relation_type: 教育哲学的两条实用主义路线：经验生长 vs 实学致用
cross_references.description_zh: 杜威以'教育即生活、学校即社会'把教育重构为经验的持续改造（M-DY 系列）；福泽以'实学'把学问定义为可验证、可日用的知识，并以庆应义塾的课程设置（数学、物理、簿记、英文）直接落地（M-FYJ-001/M-FYJ-008）。两人都拒绝了把教育当作经典背诵与身份镀金的传统。差异在于杜威以儿童的民主经验为中心，福泽以国家的文明工程为目标——个体生长与国民独立的两种实用主义。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 杜威档案（H-DY-001）未来修订时可在'教育即生活'处补一条指向 H-FYJ-001 的跨引用（实学教育的明治对照版本）。

cross_references.relation_type: 现代大学的两位奠基者：思想自由之学风 vs 实学独立之士风
cross_references.description_zh: 蔡元培以'思想自由、兼容并包'改造北京大学，把大学定义为研究高深学问的机关（M-CYP 系列）；福泽以庆应义塾把'独立自尊'定为学塾精神，以一人之为而后众人为之的士风塑造论经营学风（M-FYJ-005）。两人同为现代大学的制度奠基人，同构处在于：都相信学风（制度化的精神气质）比具体课程更决定一所学校的品格；差异在于蔡元培以宽容求真，福泽以独立致用。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 蔡元培档案（H-CYP-001）未来修订时可在'大学精神/学风'处补一条指向 H-FYJ-001 的跨引用（独立自尊学风的日本平行版本）。

cross_references.relation_type: 商业社会与言论产业：分工市场 vs 观念市场的自发秩序
cross_references.description_zh: 亚当·斯密以'看不见的手'论证分工与市场如何把自利转化为公共富足（M-ASM 系列）；福泽把言论办成《时事新报》的自负盈亏产业，以订阅与发行而非俸禄维持知识人的独立（M-FYJ-007/M-FYJ-009）。两人共享同一洞察：可持续的公共产品（富足/独立言论）不靠道德劝勉，而靠市场化的组织载体。差异在于斯密分析物品市场，福泽建造观念市场——把斯密的市场逻辑用于知识生产本身。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 亚当·斯密档案（H-ASM-001）未来修订时可在'看不见的手/分工'处补一条指向 H-FYJ-001 的跨引用（观念市场的明治应用版本）。

cross_references.relation_type: 文明自主的两极：选择性吸收与战略切割 vs 整体拒斥与乡土重建
cross_references.description_zh: 甘地以'不要孟买的文明，只要你们的文化'把西方工业文明整体拒之门外，以乡土自治重建文明主体性（M-GAN 系列）；福泽则以《脱亚论》把日本从东亚华夷秩序中战略切割，全力向西（M-FYJ-010）。两人面对同一问题——后发文明如何在强势西方面前确立自我——却给出相反答案：甘地以拒绝保全主体，福泽以切割换取主体。对照揭示了文明自主性工程的两条根本路线。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 甘地档案（H-GAN-001）未来修订时可在'文明自主/西方工业文明批判'处补一条指向 H-FYJ-001 的跨引用（脱亚切割的对极版本）。

cross_references.relation_type: 东亚启蒙的两种形态：规训君权的制度设计 vs 移植文明的国民改造
cross_references.description_zh: 黄宗羲以《明夷待访录》把'天下为主君为客'写成对君主制度的内在批判，其思想直接滋养了梁启超一代（M-HZX 系列）；福泽则跳过对旧秩序的内在批判，直接以文明论为框架从外部引进'内在精神'改造国民（M-FYJ-003/M-FYJ-006）。两人同为东亚启蒙的先声，对照在于：黄宗羲在儒学框架内挖出反抗的资源，福泽换掉框架本身——'框架内批判'与'框架外移植'是东亚现代性转型的两种经典路径。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 黄宗羲档案（H-HZX-001）未来修订时可在'明夷待访录/启蒙先声'处补一条指向 H-FYJ-001 的跨引用（框架外移植文明的明治版本）。

mode_ids_note: M-FYJ-001 ~ M-FYJ-010（figure_code=Fukuzawa → 编码 H-FYJ-001；库内查重零冲突：M-FYJ 前缀 modes_data/code_maps 无占用，C-FYJ 场景前缀无占用，H-FYJ 编码无占用。旧稿 H-FYK-167 为早期旧格式研究稿，未入主库顶层 modes，与新 v6 深挖不冲突）
caveats: 福泽谕吉生卒（1835-1901）与庆应义塾、时事新报的创办时间无争议；但《脱亚论》（1885）的真实意图存在重大史学争议——'脱亚'是否等于'侵亚'、是否为后来的军国主义张目，学界（如丸山真男、安川寿之辅、小路田泰直）立场分歧极大，引用须同时呈现争论史
'一身独立而后一国独立'常被简化为个人主义口号；其原文语境是国权与民权相互依存的论述，且福泽同时持有'官民调和'与后来转向'国权优先'的立场摇摆（1877-1890年代言论转向），引用须注明其思想分期
《文明论之概略》的'文明阶段论'（野蛮-半开-文明）带有当时流行的单线进化论色彩，现代引用须注明该框架的历史局限与殖民话语风险
'一人之为而后众人为之'的士风塑造论在《文明论之概略》中的对象是中上层的'俊秀'之士，并非普遍教育纲领——与其《劝学篇》的'万人平等'表述存在张力，不可混用
《西洋事情》的资料多译自美国与荷兰文献（Watts、Channing 等），其'条目化引介'的准确性受限于当时的翻译条件，引用具体数据须核对原文
福泽对女性教育虽有开创性论述（《女大学评论》等），但其女性观仍局限于'贤母良妻'框架，与现代女性主义话语不可直接对接

modes.domain_zh: 知识价值排序/教育哲学
modes.domain_en: Ordering of Knowledge Values / Philosophy of Education
modes.definition_zh: 福泽把学问一刀切成『虚学』与『实学』：远离实用、只作装饰的汉学训诂与词章之学是虚学，能验证、能解决眼前实际问题的知识才是实学。他不是说古书无用，而是给知识排出一个可操作的优先级——离人的日用越近、越可验证，价值越高。这一排序的深层是一个反权威的认识论判断：知识的价值不由经典源头授予，而由经验效果授予。方法上这意味着：评估任何知识（或课程、或技能清单）时，先问『它能否被验证、能否解决眼前问题』，再谈其传承与谱系。
modes.definition_en: Fukuzawa cut learning in two: 'kyogaku' (hollow learning) and 'jitsugaku' (practical learning). Classical exegesis and ornamental composition, divorced from use, are hollow; knowledge that can be verified and solves immediate problems is practical. He never said the classics were useless—he gave knowledge an operational priority order: the closer to daily use and the more verifiable, the higher the value. Beneath the ordering lies an anti-authoritarian epistemological claim: a piece of knowledge's worth is conferred by its experiential effects, not by its canonical provenance. Methodologically: when evaluating any body of knowledge (a curriculum, a skill list), first ask whether it is verifiable and solves problems at hand; only then discuss its lineage.
modes.source_chapter: 《劝学篇》初编：学问的旨趣在于实学，非训诂词章；《福翁自传》论兰学之实用
modes.key_quote_zh: 学问的旨趣不在于训诂词章之虚，而在于能解决眼前实际问题的实学。
modes.key_quote_en: The point of learning lies not in the hollowness of exegesis and rhetoric, but in practical learning that solves the problems at hand.
process_zh: 把目标领域的全部知识列成清单，标注其『可验证性』与『距日用的距离』
以『能否解决眼前实际问题』为第一过滤器，切分实学与虚学
资源与课时向实学倾斜，虚学仅保留其具审美或工具价值的残余
定期重估排序：曾被判为虚学的内容若出现验证手段，即移回实学
process_en: List all knowledge in the target domain, tagging each item's verifiability and distance from daily use
Use 'does it solve a problem at hand' as the first filter to split practical from hollow learning
Tilt resources and curriculum time toward practical learning; retain hollow learning only for residual aesthetic or instrumental value
Re-estimate the ordering periodically: anything once judged hollow regains practical status the moment a verification method appears
representative_cases_zh: 《劝学篇》开篇即以『天不造人上人』引出学问应致日用：学以立身谋生、理解时务，而非作诗应酬
庆应义塾课程以数学、物理、簿记、英文为主体，刻意压缩汉学经义，使兰学与英学合流为可验证的实学体系
《西洋事情》不做文明史的抒情铺陈，而以政治制度、经济统计、兵制税法的条目化整理直接供给幕府与维新政府的决策参考
反例警示：明治后期『实学』被矮化为只为致富谋职的技术训练，福泽晚年重申独立尊严是实学的灵魂——抽掉价值内核的实学会退化为功利主义
representative_cases_en: Gakumon no Susume opens with 'Heaven made no man above another' to argue that learning should serve daily use: learning for livelihood and public affairs, not for versifying
Keio's curriculum centered on mathematics, physics, bookkeeping, and English, deliberately shrinking classical exegesis so Dutch and English studies fused into a verifiable practical system
Seiyo Jijo offered no lyrical civilization history but itemized political institutions, economic statistics, and military-fiscal systems as direct decision input for bakufu and Meiji officials

Counterexample: later Meiji debased 'jitsugaku' into mere vocational training for wealth; in his last years Fukuzawa reasserted that independence and dignity are jitsugaku's soul—strip the value core and practical learning degenerates into utilitarianism
modern_applications_zh: 课程设计：以可验证性与问题解决力为第一排序轴
企业培训：优先投资能立刻改善决策与执行的知识，砍掉装饰性资质
个人学习规划：用『距日用的距离』给学习清单排序，拒绝证书收集癖
政策评估：判断一项公共教育投入产出的是可验证能力还是文凭信号
modern_applications_en: Curriculum design: rank by verifiability and problem-solving power first
Corporate training: invest first in knowledge that immediately improves decisions and execution; cut decorative credentials
Personal learning plans: order your list by distance from daily use; refuse the certificate-collecting habit
Policy evaluation: ask whether public education spending yields verifiable capability or mere diploma signaling

modes.domain_zh: 个人与国家关系/启蒙伦理
modes.definition_zh: 『一身独立而后一国独立』：福泽把国家独立的充要条件还原为国民个体的独立——有独立精神与独立能力的人，才会在被外力威逼时站出来守住国权；满国都是依附性的臣民，制度上的独立只是空壳。这一还原把『国家富强』这个宏观问题翻译成『人格养成』这个微观问题，把启蒙从制度移植的层面拉回到人的层面。方法上这意味着：评估任何集体目标时，先检查支撑它的微观主体能力是否真实存在，不存在则先补主体，再谈目标。
modes.definition_en: 'One individual's independence precedes the nation's independence': Fukuzawa reduced national independence to the independence of individuals—a person with an independent spirit and capacity will stand up to protect the nation's sovereignty under external coercion; a country full of dependent subjects holds institutional independence as an empty shell. This reduction translates the macro problem of national wealth and power into the micro problem of character formation, pulling enlightenment back from institutional transplantation to the level of persons. Methodologically: when assessing any collective goal, first check whether the micro-level agent capacities that support it actually exist; if not, build the agents before chasing the goal.
modes.source_chapter: 《劝学篇》第三编：一身独立而后一国独立；《文明论之概略》论『一国之人之智德』
modes.key_quote_zh: 一身独立而后一国独立——国的独立是果，人的独立是因。
modes.key_quote_en: The individual's independence comes before the nation's: national independence is the fruit; personal independence is the root.
process_zh: 把集体目标（富强、独立、竞争力）分解为其所依赖的微观主体能力
盘点这些主体能力在人群中真实存在的比例与分布
缺什么补什么：先做主体养成（教育、产权、心理独立），后做目标动员
以微观主体的行为改变为验收标准，而非以口号与仪式为验收标准
process_en: Decompose the collective goal (wealth, independence, competitiveness) into the micro agent capacities it depends on
Inventory the real proportion and distribution of those capacities in the population
Fill what is missing: build agents first (education, property rights, psychological independence), mobilize for goals after
Acceptance is measured by changed behavior of individuals, not by slogans and rituals
representative_cases_zh: 《劝学篇》发行三百四十万册，把『独立自尊』写进数代日本人的自我期许，成为明治国民人格的底层脚本
庆应义塾拒绝官学化：学费自付、毕业生不荫官职，以『独立自尊』为校训培养不依附官方的人格
《时事新报》以『独立不羁』为社训，声明议论不媚政府、不媚党派、不媚财阀——言论独立的底气来自报馆自身的财务独立
反例警示：福泽的『独立』预设了男性户主视角，其国民人格论对女性与被殖民者的独立如何安放缺乏构想，移植此法须先做主体范围校正
representative_cases_en: Gakumon no Susume sold 3.4 million copies, writing 'independence and self-respect' into generations of Japanese self-expectation as the底层 script of the Meiji national personality
Keio refused official status: fees paid by students, graduates given no official patronage—'independence and self-respect' cultivated personalities unattached to the state
Jiji Shinpo's motto 'independence and untrammeled spirit' declared commentary that flattered neither government, party, nor zaibatsu—freedom of speech backed by the paper's own financial independence

Counterexample: Fukuzawa's 'independence' presupposed a male-householder perspective; his national-personality theory left women's and the colonized's independence unaddressed—transplanting the method requires correcting the scope of 'agent' first
modern_applications_zh: 组织变革：把『数字化转型』还原为每个人的技能与激励改造，而非买系统
公共治理：先培育公民的产权、契约与参与能力，再谈制度移植
家庭教育：培养孩子的独立判断与生存能力优先于升学指标
企业战略：检查每个集体KPI背后是否真实存在对应的个体能力
modern_applications_en: Organizational change: reduce 'digital transformation' to each person's skills and incentives, not buying systems
Public governance: cultivate citizens' property, contract, and participation capacities before transplanting institutions
Family education: prioritize children's independent judgment and survival skills over admission metrics
Corporate strategy: verify that the individual capacities behind each collective KPI actually exist

modes.definition_zh: 《文明论之概略》把文明拆成两层：外在的『文明外形』——铁路、轮船、宪法、法律条文——与内在的『文明精神』——一国之人对独立与公共事务的态度、风气与人心的厚度。外形可以购买与移植，内在却无法购买，只能自我生长；模仿外形而内在空洞，叫『文明的假面』。这一两轴拆分提供了一个现代化的诊断工具：任何『像现代但不是现代』的病灶，都出在外形与内在的错位。方法上这意味着：诊断任何落后与失灵，先区分问题是设备（外形）还是风气（内在），两者的药方完全不同。
modes.definition_en: Bunmeiron no Gairyaku splits civilization into two layers: the outer 'form'—railways, steamships, constitutions, legal texts—and the inner 'spirit'—a people's attitude toward independence and public affairs, the thickness of prevailing ethos. The form can be bought and transplanted; the spirit cannot be bought, only grown. Mimicking the form while hollow inside is 'the mask of civilization.' This two-axis split is a diagnostic tool for modernization: any pathology of 'looking modern but not being modern' lies in the mismatch of form and spirit. Methodologically: in diagnosing backwardness or dysfunction, first decide whether the problem is equipment (form) or ethos (spirit); the prescriptions differ entirely.
modes.source_chapter: 《文明论之概略》第六章：智德之辩与文明的精神；『外在文明易取，内在文明难求』
modes.key_quote_zh: 外在的文明易取，内在的文明难求——形体既得而精神不随，则文明终为假面。
modes.key_quote_en: The outer civilization is easily acquired, the inner civilization hard to win: gain the form without the spirit, and civilization remains a mask.
process_zh: 把观察到的『现代性要素』按外形/内在分拣：可购买物 vs 风气与人的态度
诊断外形与内在是否错位：制度文本先进而执行风气不变即为假面
外形问题用采购与移植解决，内在问题只能用长期教育与示范解决
警惕『补外形』的路径依赖：外形堆得越多，内在的欠账越被遮蔽
process_en: Sort observed 'modern elements' into form vs spirit: purchasables vs ethos and attitudes
Diagnose mismatch: advanced institutional texts with unchanged ethos of execution = the mask
Solve form problems by procurement and transplantation; solve spirit problems only by long-term education and demonstration
Beware path dependence on patching form: the more form is piled up, the more the spirit's deficit is hidden
representative_cases_zh: 福泽初见横滨开港后的洋货贸易即领悟：只是买进器物而无法律信用与商政之实，文明仍在外表
《文明论之概略》以『外形之文明与内在之文明』评价明治维新：宪法兵制可一夜颁行，而人民独立风气需数十年养成
《西洋事情》刻意写制度与统计而非风物见闻——他向日本输送的正是文明的外形清单，同时告诫内在须自养
反例警示：此两轴法被后世滥用为『国民性落后论』的话术，把制度失败归罪于人民精神——须记住福泽的原意是先改风气且由精英垂范，而非为既得利益开脱
representative_cases_en: Seeing Yokohama's opened-port trade, Fukuzawa grasped at once: buying artifacts without legal credit and real commerce keeps civilization at the surface
Bunmeiron judged the Meiji Restoration by 'outer and inner civilization': constitutions and military codes can be promulgated overnight, the people's ethos of independence takes decades
Seiyo Jijo deliberately described institutions and statistics rather than travel scenery—delivering to Japan a checklist of civilization's form while warning that the inner must be self-grown

Counterexample: later abusers turned the two axes into 'national character backwardness' rhetoric, blaming institutional failure on the people's spirit—Fukuzawa's intent was to change the ethos first, with elites setting the example, not to excuse vested interests
modern_applications_zh: 企业引进诊断：新系统上线而行为不变，是外形移植失败而非员工素质问题
制度移植评估：区分条文（外形）与执行风气（内在），避免『宪法好看司法不行』
技术转移项目：把风气养成列为交付物，而非只交付设备与手册
组织文化审计：识别『价值观上墙、行为不上墙』的文明假面
modern_applications_en: Adoption audits: new system live but behavior unchanged is a failed form transplant, not a staff-quality problem
Institutional transfer: separate legal text (form) from execution ethos (spirit); avoid 'fine constitution, weak courts'
Technology transfer: make ethos-building a deliverable, not just equipment and manuals
Culture audits: detect 'values on the wall, not in behavior'—the mask of civilization

modes.domain_en: Stage Theory of Civilization / Catch-up Strategy
modes.definition_zh: 福泽把世界各文明排在一条单向阶梯上：野蛮—半开化—文明。排序不是为羞辱谁，而是制造一个可操作的『位差』概念：落后者先要定位自己与文明阶梯上游的准确距离，再决定是『整体跃迁』还是『分步补课』。他给日本的诊断是半开化位，并主张一步到位取『文明位』的政教风俗为目标，而非在半开化位内修修补补。位差思维的价值在于：它把『学习西方』这个情绪化口号换算成『补哪几门课、按什么顺序』的工程问题。方法上这意味着：追赶之前，先精确测绘自己与目标在哪些维度差多少，再排补课顺序。
modes.definition_en: Fukuzawa ranked civilizations on a one-way ladder: barbarism, semi-enlightenment, civilization. The ranking is not humiliation but an operational concept of 'gap': the laggard must first map its exact distance from the ladder's upper reaches, then decide between wholesale leap and stepwise remediation. His diagnosis placed Japan at the semi-enlightened rung and urged taking the civilized rung's polity and ethos as the direct target, not patching within semi-enlightenment. The value of gap-thinking: it converts the emotional slogan 'learn from the West' into the engineering question 'which subjects to remediate, in what order.' Methodologically: before catching up, precisely measure on which dimensions you trail by how much; then sequence the remediation.
modes.source_chapter: 《文明论之概略》第一、四章：文明之义与以一国为目的；『以西方文明为目标』论
modes.key_quote_zh: 以西方文明为目标，取其所长而补我所无——位差既明，补课有序。
modes.key_quote_en: Take Western civilization as the target, adopt its strengths to fill our lacks: once the gap is measured, remediation can be sequenced.
process_zh: 以多维度（智、德、制度、产业）绘制自己与目标文明的位置坐标
承认位差的事实性，拒绝自卑或自大两种情绪化反应
选择目标位而非相邻位：直接以最上游的风俗政教为基准，跳过中间形态
按依赖关系排序补课：智识与人才先于产业，产业先于军备
process_en: Plot your position and the target civilization's on multiple dimensions (wisdom, virtue, institutions, industry)
Accept the gap as fact, rejecting both inferiority and conceit as emotional noise
Target the upper rung, not the neighboring one: benchmark directly against the most advanced ethos and polity, skipping intermediate forms
Sequence remediation by dependency: knowledge and talent before industry, industry before armament
representative_cases_zh: 《文明论之概略》以『智德』两维给意大利文艺复兴、荷兰、英、美、法排位，再定位日本：制度初立而风气未改，居半开化位
主张日本不应以中国式『 Partial 改良』为目标，而应以英美式文明为目标——『取其上则得其中』
《西洋事情》按政治、财政、军事分科汇编西方实况，等于开出文明位差的分科补课清单
反例警示：文明阶梯的单向排序后来被挪用为殖民扩张的正当化话术（《脱亚论》即含此毒），使用位差概念必须与价值等级脱钩
representative_cases_en: Bunmeiron ranked the Italian Renaissance, Holland, England, America, and France on two axes of wisdom and virtue, then placed Japan: institutions newly built, ethos unchanged—semi-enlightened
He urged Japan not to aim at partial improvement but at Anglo-American civilization outright—'aim high and you land in the middle'
Seiyo Jijo compiled Western realities by politics, finance, and military affairs—effectively a subject-by-subject remediation list of the civilizational gap
Counterexample: the one-way ladder was later commandeered to justify colonial expansion (Datsu-A Ron carries this poison); the gap concept must be decoupled from value ranking
modern_applications_zh: 技术追赶：先做与前沿的分维度差距测绘，再排攻关顺序
企业对标：以全球最上游为基准设定目标，避免向同行中位看齐
教育与课程改革：按『基础学科先于应用学科』排补课顺序
地区发展：拒绝形象工程（相邻位装饰），直接对标目标位的核心制度
modern_applications_en: Technology catch-up: map dimensional gaps against the frontier before sequencing R&D
Corporate benchmarking: set targets against the global best, not the industry median
Education reform: sequence remediation as fundamentals before applications
Regional development: refuse showcase projects (neighboring-rung decoration); benchmark the target rung's core institutions directly

modes.definition_zh: 『凡国人能为而今日不能为者，必有一人先为之』：福泽认为内在文明（风气）无法用政令直接改变，唯一的启动机制是有人率先垂范——先知先觉者独自承担嘲笑与风险把新行为做出来，众人观望，渐次跟进，风气遂成。政令只能改变外形，垂范才能改变人心。这一机制把社会变革的重心从『多数决』转移到『先行者个人』：变革者要研究的不是如何说服多数，而是如何让自己成为第一个可被模仿的样本，并活到样本被模仿的那天。方法上这意味着：推动风气型变革时，先做出一个可见、可复制、先行者可存活的示范样本。
modes.definition_en: 'Whatever a nation's people can do but do not do today, one man must do first': Fukuzawa held that inner civilization—ethos—cannot be changed by decree; the only ignition mechanism is someone going first. The awakening pioneer bears ridicule and risk alone, performs the new behavior, the many watch, follow by degrees, and ethos forms. Decree changes the form; example changes the heart. This shifts the center of social change from majority consensus to the individual pioneer: the reformer studies not how to persuade the many but how to become the first imitable sample—and to survive until the sample is imitated. Methodologically: to move ethos-type change, first produce a visible, replicable demonstration that the pioneer can survive.
modes.source_chapter: 《文明论之概略》第十章：论一身独立之风；『一人之为，众人效之』风气形成论
modes.key_quote_zh: 国人能为而今日未能之事，必待一人先为之——风气之成，始于一人之勇。
modes.key_quote_en: What the nation could do but does not yet do waits for one man to do first: ethos begins with one person's courage.
process_zh: 识别目标风气对应的具体行为（而非口号）
以自身或示范者做出该行为的公开、完整、可核查样本
让先行样本存活足够久：经济自养与舆论自护双保险
降低模仿门槛：把样本拆解成可复制的程序，等待观望者跟进
process_en: Identify the concrete behavior (not slogan) that constitutes the target ethos
Produce a public, complete, auditable sample of that behavior via self or demonstrator
Keep the pioneer sample alive long enough: dual insurance of economic self-support and public-opinion self-defense
Lower imitation costs: decompose the sample into replicable procedure and wait for the watchers to follow
representative_cases_zh: 福泽本人拒受官爵终身在野：以私人身份办学办报，示范『体制外知识分子』这一新身份可以存活且体面
庆应义塾学生不讲门阀只讲成绩：在身份制日本率先示范『能力本位』的人际秩序
《时事新报》率先实行新闻公开批评政府并存活数十年，证明言论产业可自立
反例警示：先行者若只出姿态不建可持续样本（无财务自养），垂范会退化为作秀，风气不生反生嘲讽
representative_cases_en: Fukuzawa refused titles all his life, staying outside office: founding school and paper as a private person, demonstrating that the 'independent intellectual outside the establishment' could survive with dignity
Keio students ranked by merit, not lineage: in status-bound Japan, a first demonstration of merit-based social order
Jiji Shinpo openly criticized the government for decades and survived, proving a discourse industry could stand on its own
Counterexample: pioneers who perform gestures without a sustainable sample (no financial self-support) turn exemplarity into showmanship—ethos does not form, mockery does
modern_applications_zh: 组织文化变革：高管亲自做出新行为并长期公开可见，胜过发布价值观文件
开源社区：第一个持续维护的高质量项目就是风气本身
公共议题倡导：做出可核查的示范（而非只做声明），让观望者有模仿对象
个人影响力：在目标圈层率先做出稀缺行为并存活，自动获得定义权
modern_applications_en: Culture change: executives personally perform the new behavior, visibly and durably—better than publishing a values memo
Open source: one continuously maintained high-quality project is the ethos itself
Advocacy: produce auditable demonstrations, not declarations, so watchers have something to imitate
Personal influence: perform a scarce behavior first in your target circle and survive—definition rights follow

modes.definition_zh: 福泽三次随团出访欧美（1860、1861、1867），每次都把访问当作『取景』而非『观礼』：他买书、抄制度文本、记统计数字、追问操作细节（美国法庭怎么判案、荷兰医院怎么收费），把西方拆成可带走的分科信息包。关键的取景纪律有二：一是越过表层（不止看议会大厦，而看议会怎么运转）；二是带回原文与数据而非感想。这一方法把『走向世界』从猎奇转变为系统性的知识引进工程。方法上这意味着：考察任何外部先进系统时，按分科清单取景、以原始文本与数据回填，拒绝感想式报告。
modes.definition_en: Fukuzawa joined three missions to the West (1860, 1861, 1867), treating each as 'framing shots' rather than ceremonial sightseeing: he bought books, copied institutional texts, recorded statistics, and probed operational details (how American courts decide, how Dutch hospitals bill), dismantling the West into exportable, discipline-sorted information packages. Two disciplines governed his framing: go past the surface (not how the parliament building looks but how parliament runs), and bring back source texts and data, not impressions. This turned 'going global' from exoticism into a systematic knowledge-import engineering project. Methodologically: when investigating any advanced external system, frame by discipline checklist and backfill with primary texts and data; refuse impressionistic reports.
modes.source_chapter: 《福翁自传》：三度随使欧美之采择；《西洋事情》编写凡例
modes.key_quote_zh: 观人国者，不观其楼台之壮，而观其法度之所以行。
modes.key_quote_en: To observe a nation, look not at its towers but at how its laws actually run.
process_zh: 出发前编制分科取景清单（政制、司法、财税、教育、军事、统计）
现场只采集操作细节：谁在做、怎么做、依据什么文本、花多少钱
带回原文文本与原始数据，拒绝以转述与感想充当证据
回国即把信息包翻译、汇编、出版，转化为公共知识产品
process_en: Before departure, draft a discipline-sorted framing checklist (polity, judiciary, fiscal, education, military, statistics)
On site collect only operational detail: who does what, how, under which text, at what cost
Bring back source texts and raw data; never let paraphrase and impressions serve as evidence
On return, translate, compile, and publish the packages, converting them into public knowledge products
representative_cases_zh: 《西洋事情》初编再编合刊逾百万部，其材料几乎全部来自福泽自购西书与使节团中的现场抄录
1860年访美时他专问『合众国政治何以自立』并携回韦伯斯特词典等文本，为英语教育与法政译介奠基
《西洋事情》不仅引介制度条文，还以问答体预演『此制于我国可行否』——取景与本土化评估一体完成
反例警示：同期岩仓使节团以观礼与外交为主线，知识产出远逊——取景若无清单与回填纪律，出洋即成游历
representative_cases_en: Seiyo Jijo's combined editions sold over a million; its materials came almost entirely from books Fukuzawa bought and documents copied on the missions
Visiting America in 1860 he pressed on 'how the Union's politics sustain themselves' and carried back Webster's dictionary and other texts, founding English education and legal translation
Seiyo Jijo introduced institutional texts and, in Q&A form, rehearsed 'would this work for Japan?'—framing and localization assessment completed in one motion
Counterexample: the contemporary Iwakura Mission, centered on ceremony and diplomacy, produced far less knowledge—without checklist and backfill discipline, going abroad is just sightseeing
modern_applications_zh: 企业海外考察：带着分科清单去，带原文与数据回，拒绝导游式参观
竞品研究：采集操作细节（定价、流程、SLA），不做观感评论
学术访问与访学：以可核验文本与数据集为产出标准
个人跨界学习：每次接触新领域，先编制该领域的取景清单
modern_applications_en: Overseas company visits: go with a discipline checklist, return with texts and data, refuse guided-tour style sightseeing
Competitive research: collect operational detail (pricing, process, SLA); skip impressions
Academic visits: take verifiable texts and datasets as the output standard
Personal cross-domain learning: draft that domain's framing checklist before first contact

modes.definition_zh: 福泽深知言论要独立，先要算账：不拿政府补贴、不靠党派供养的报纸，必须靠发行与广告养活自己，否则『独立不羁』只是欠薪者的修辞。1882年他创办《时事新报》，以庆应义塾的人才与财务体系托底，声明『议论唯依独立之宗旨』，不媚政府、不媚党派、不媚有产者。他把办报当作产业来经营：稳定的读者市场、可复制的编辑流程、与学校的人才闭环。方法上这意味着：任何想保持独立立场的言论主体，第一工程不是修炼勇气，而是建设不依赖被批评方的现金流结构。
modes.definition_en: Fukuzawa knew speech must first balance its books: a paper taking no government subsidy and no party stipend must live on circulation and advertising, or 'independence and untrammeled spirit' is the rhetoric of the underpaid. In 1882 he founded Jiji Shinpo, backstopped by Keio's personnel and finances, declaring commentary to follow only 'the principle of independence'—flattering neither government, party, nor property. He ran the newspaper as an industry: a stable reader market, replicable editorial process, and a talent loop with the school. Methodologically: for any discourse actor seeking independence, the first project is not cultivating courage but building a cash-flow structure that does not depend on the entity being criticized.
modes.source_chapter: 《时事新报》发刊之趣旨（1882）：独立不羁之宗旨；《福翁自传》论办报
modes.key_quote_zh: 议论唯依独立之宗旨，不媚政府，不媚党派——言论之独立，始于报馆之自养。
modes.key_quote_en: Commentary follows the principle of independence alone, flattering neither government nor party: independent speech begins with a newspaper that pays its own bills.
process_zh: 绘制现金流的依赖地图：收入来自谁，谁的批评成本最高
重构收入结构，使被批评方不进入主要收入来源
建立不依赖外部输血的组织托底（人才、品牌、固定资产）
公开声明编辑独立原则并反复自我执行，把立场变成品牌资产
process_en: Map the cash-flow dependency: whose money comes in, and against whom is the cost of criticism highest
Restructure revenue so the criticized party is outside core income
Build an organizational backstop that needs no external transfusion (talent, brand, fixed assets)
Declare editorial-independence principles publicly and enforce them repeatedly, converting stance into brand equity
representative_cases_zh: 《时事新报》声明独立不羁，敢于连载批评藩阀政府的评论而不因财政被收编
以庆应义塾毕业生充任记者编辑，形成『学堂—报馆』人才闭环，编辑立场可长期一致
福泽为保言论独立屡拒官方职位与资助，把『不欠体制的人情』做成报馆的资产
反例警示：其报业后期亦涉『社论与经营暧昧』之讥（对政党明暗两手），言论产业的独立性是持续审计而非一劳永逸的资产
representative_cases_en: Jiji Shinpo declared independence and serialized criticism of the hanbatsu government without being bought through finance
Keio graduates staffed the newsroom, forming a school-paper talent loop that kept editorial lines consistent for decades
Fukuzawa repeatedly declined official posts and subsidies to protect free speech, making 'owing the establishment nothing' a house asset

Counterexample: his paper's later years drew charges of editorial-commercial entanglement (overt-covert dual handling of parties); independence in the discourse industry is a continuous audit, not a one-time asset
modern_applications_zh: 独立媒体：先设计不依赖被监督对象的商业模式，再谈监督勇气
独立研究者：以多元收入（咨询、课程、出版）对冲对单一资助方的依赖
NGO与智库：公开资金来源并设防火墙，把独立性做成可审计资产
内容创作者：建设自有发行渠道，减少平台依赖以保批评自由
modern_applications_en: Independent media: design a business model independent of the supervised before preaching courage
Independent researchers: diversify income (consulting, courses, publishing) against single-funder dependence
NGOs and think tanks: disclose funding and build firewalls, making independence an auditable asset
Creators: build owned distribution channels to reduce platform dependence and preserve the freedom to criticize

modes.definition_zh: 福泽的启蒙不是沙龙讲学，而是产业运营：教科书按市场定价与再版节奏滚动（《劝学篇》合刊销行三百四十万册）、学校以学费自养并滚动扩招（庆应义塾）、译书按分科系列化出版（《西洋事情》系列）。他把『让更多人知道』翻译成三个可运营变量：内容降门槛（白话、浅显、切用）、渠道规模化（学校、报纸、书籍三渠道）、供给可复制（教材、师资、编辑流程标准化）。方法上这意味着：任何想扩大影响的知识主体，别问『如何让更多人认同』，先问『内容、渠道、复制的三张运营表长什么样』。
modes.definition_en: Fukuzawa's enlightenment was not salon lecturing but industrial operation: textbooks rolling through market pricing and reprints (Gakumon no Susume's combined edition sold 3.4 million), a school self-financed by fees and expanding (Keio), translations published as serial discipline series (Seiyo Jijo). He translated 'let more people know' into three operable variables: lower content thresholds (vernacular, plain, applicable), scale channels (school, newspaper, book as three channels), and replicable supply (standardized textbooks, teacher corps, editorial process). Methodologically: any knowledge actor seeking wider reach should not ask 'how to win more agreement' but 'what do the three operating sheets—content, channel, replication—look like.'
modes.source_chapter: 《劝学篇》合刊之流传与定价策略；《福翁自传》论庆应义塾经营
modes.key_quote_zh: 学問のすゝめ以浅显白话写深理，合刊三百四十万部——启蒙是产业，不是布道。
modes.key_quote_en: Gakumon no Susume wrote deep principles in plain vernacular, 3.4 million copies in combined edition: enlightenment is an industry, not a sermon.
process_zh: 把目标知识改写为目标人群的日用语言，删除需要门槛的前置条件
铺设多渠道分发（学校课程、报刊连载、书籍市场），各渠道互相导流
标准化供给：教材、师资、编辑流程模板化，使扩张不依赖个人
以财务自养为扩张约束：学费、发行收入覆盖运营，拒绝供养式扩张
process_en: Rewrite target knowledge in the daily language of the target audience; delete prerequisite门槛 conditions
Lay multi-channel distribution (school curriculum, press serialization, book market) with cross-traffic between channels
Standardize supply: templated textbooks, teacher corps, editorial process, so growth depends on no single person
Take financial self-support as the growth constraint: fees and circulation cover operations; refuse subsidy-driven expansion
representative_cases_zh: 《劝学篇》以汉文训读体混合白话连载十七编，识字商人也可读——内容降门槛的直接结果是其天文销量
庆应义塾以学费自养滚动扩张，不用藩费官费，扩张节奏与教学质量由市场校验
《西洋事情》系列化分科出版，从初编到再编按读者反馈迭代——启蒙产品有版本管理
反例警示：普及化会稀释深度——福泽以『实学的门槛必须保留』自限，凡须严格训练的科目（如数学）坚持不为销量降格
representative_cases_en: Gakumon no Susume serialized seventeen installments in mixed kanbun-vernacular readable by literate merchants—lowered thresholds yielded astronomical sales
Keio expanded on tuition revenue alone, no domain or state funds; pace and quality were checked by the market
Seiyo Jijo appeared as a discipline-sorted series, revised from first to second editions on reader feedback—enlightenment products had version management
Counterexample: massification dilutes depth—Fukuzawa self-limited by 'jitsugaku's threshold must be kept'; subjects demanding strict training (mathematics) were never debased for sales
modern_applications_zh: 知识付费与在线教育：内容降门槛+渠道矩阵+供给标准化三件套
开源文档工程：把专业知识改写为入门路径并做版本迭代
公共科普：用日用语言与多渠道分发，拒绝圈内自嗨
个人品牌：把知识封装为可复制的课程与文本产品，而非依赖出场费
modern_applications_en: Edtech and paid knowledge: threshold-lowering + channel matrix + standardized supply
Open-source documentation: rewrite expertise into onboarding paths with version iteration
Public science communication: daily language and multi-channel distribution over insider self-congratulation
Personal brands: package knowledge into replicable course and text products, not appearance fees
representative_figures: 平冢らんでん（平冢雷鸟）

modes.domain_zh: 知识分子角色/政府监督
modes.definition_zh: 福泽给明治日本的读书人设定了一个新角色——『时务人士』（時間に目覚めた人）：不进政府做官吏，也不做清议的隐士，而以独立的言论与教育在政府外部形成监督与向导。他的理由是结构性的：官吏是政府的手足，加入即失去批判位置；而文明国家需要一支『政府之外的良知与智力』来纠偏。这一角色设定把『入仕还是出世』的古典两难拆掉了第三条路：体制外的专业监督者。方法上这意味着：面对组织或政府的失灵，先问体制内外哪一侧的杠杆更有效，再选择自己的位置，并以自养保障位置的可持续。
modes.definition_en: Fukuzawa designed a new role for Japan's educated: the 'man of the hour'—not entering government as an official, nor retiring into pure criticism, but forming oversight and guidance outside government through independent speech and education. His reason was structural: officials are the government's hands and feet; joining forfeits the critical position, while a civilized country needs a corps of 'conscience and intellect outside government' for correction. This splits the classical dilemma of 'serve or withdraw' open with a third road: the professional monitor outside the establishment. Methodologically: facing organizational or governmental failure, first ask which side's leverage is more effective, choose your position, and secure it through self-financing.
modes.source_chapter: 《时事小言》(1881)：时务人士论与独立言论之职分；《劝学篇》论学者之职分
modes.key_quote_zh: 学者不当做政府的手足，当做政府的镜子——在野之身，监督之势。
modes.key_quote_en: The scholar should be the government's mirror, not its hands and feet: an out-of-office position with a monitoring function.
process_zh: 评估目标体制的纠错通道：体制内谏言与体制外监督哪个杠杆更长
选定位置后以自养（经营、教学、出版）保障位置不被收买或饿死
以专业深度而非道德姿态建立监督公信力：批评必须附方案与证据
与体制保持可对话但不依附的关系：留出被咨询的接口，不放弃批评权
process_en: Assess the regime's error-correction channels: which lever is longer, insider remonstrance or outsider monitoring
After choosing position, secure it via self-financing (business, teaching, publishing) so it can be neither bought nor starved
Build monitoring credibility on professional depth, not moral posture: criticism must carry plans and evidence
Keep a dialogic but unattached relation with the establishment: leave an interface to be consulted without surrendering the right to criticize
representative_cases_zh: 福泽终身在野：屡拒藩阀政府授爵与官职，以庆应义塾与《时事新报》为据点监督政府
《时事小言》提出时务人士应在政府外『独立而不羁』，成为明治在野知识分子的角色宣言
《时事新报》对政府既有猛烈批评，也长期向官方供给国际情报与政策分析——监督与咨询双通道
反例警示：其『在野』并不拒绝影响力交易，晚年亦曾以言论间接为政府外交背书——体制外监督者的中立性需要持续自我审计
representative_cases_en: Fukuzawa stayed outside office all his life, repeatedly declining titles and posts from the hanbatsu government, running oversight from Keio and Jiji Shinpo
Jiji Shogen (1881) declared that men of the hour should be 'independent and untrammeled' outside government—a role manifesto for Meiji's out-of-office intellectuals
Jiji Shinpo both criticized the government fiercely and long supplied it international intelligence and policy analysis—dual channels of monitoring and consultation
Counterexample: his 'outsider' status did not preclude influence-trading; late in life his press indirectly endorsed government diplomacy—the outsider monitor's neutrality needs continuous self-audit
modern_applications_zh: 职业选择：评估进组织改造组织 vs 留在外部监督组织哪边杠杆更大
独立董事与审计：以专业与自养保障监督位置的可信度
智库与学院：与政府保持咨询接口但拒绝编制化
技术社区：以外部标准（规范、审计、基准）监督平台与厂商
modern_applications_en: Career choice: weigh the leverage of entering to reform vs staying outside to monitor
Independent directors and auditors: credibility of the monitor position secured by expertise and self-support
Think tanks and academia: keep consultation interfaces with government while refusing incorporation
Tech communities: monitor platforms and vendors through external standards (specs, audits, benchmarks)

modes.definition_zh: 1885年《脱亚论》宣称：日本不再等待与中国、朝鲜共荣于文明，而应『谢绝亚细亚东方之恶友』，与西方文明国共进退。抛开其论证中的殖民主义毒素，此文的底层是一个冷酷的取舍结构：当旧的联盟圈层在拖累你的升级路径时，切割虽然道义难堪，却可能比等待对方改造更快保全自身。福泽的推演是位差逻辑的延伸——半开化的邻国维持旧秩序，则日本的一切文明化投入都会被地缘捆绑消耗。方法上这意味着：评估任何长期联盟时，以『对方的发展轨迹是否拖累自己的升级路径』为独立变量，切割是工具而非立场，使用时必须诚实标注其道德代价。
modes.definition_en: In Datsu-A Ron (1885) Fukuzawa proclaimed that Japan would no longer wait with China and Korea for shared civilization but should 'refuse the bad friends of East Asia' and stand with the Western civilized nations. Setting aside the colonial poison in its argument, the underlying structure is a cold tradeoff: when an old alliance circle drags your upgrade path, severance—though morally ugly—may preserve yourself faster than waiting for the other's reform. His reasoning extends the gap logic: semi-enlightened neighbors upholding the old order would let geopolitics consume every civilizing investment Japan made. Methodologically: in evaluating any long-term alliance, treat 'does the partner's trajectory drag my upgrade path' as an independent variable; severance is a tool, not a stance, and using it requires honestly marking its moral cost.
modes.source_chapter: 《脱亚论》(1885, 《时事新报》)；《文明论之概略》文明位差论为其底本
modes.key_quote_zh: 谢绝东方之恶友，与西洋文明国共进退——切割是取舍，不是仇恨。
modes.key_quote_en: Refuse the bad friends of the East and advance or retreat with the civilized West: severance is a tradeoff, not hatred.
process_zh: 以升级路径为主线评估每个联盟：它是加速器还是捆绑消耗
量化切割成本与留存成本：道义资产、市场依赖、安全依赖
设定切割触发条件与替代方案，避免情绪化断链
为切割行为诚实标注道德代价并承担其后果，拒绝正当化叙事
process_en: Evaluate every alliance against your upgrade path: accelerator or bundled drag
Quantify severance cost vs retention cost: moral capital, market dependence, security dependence
Set severance triggers and alternatives in advance; avoid emotional chain-breaking
Honestly mark the moral cost of severance and bear its consequences; refuse legitimizing narratives
representative_cases_zh: 《脱亚论》以中朝两国不改旧制为由主张战略切割，成为日本大陆政策的舆论先声
福泽拒绝以『同文同种』的情感绑定为外交前提，把国际关系还原为利益与位差的计算
切割之外亦有保留：《时事新报》对中国的报道仍维持情报与商业网络，切割是战略定位而非全面断交
反例警示：此法的历史后果是助长了对中朝的歧视与侵略正当化——位差判断一旦滑向价值贬低与扩张行动，即从战略工具变为战争借口，使用此法者必须以《脱亚论》的结局为永戒
representative_cases_en: Datsu-A Ron urged strategic severance on the grounds that China and Korea would not reform—becoming the public-opinion prelude of Japan's continental policy
Fukuzawa refused 'same script, same race' sentimental bonds as diplomatic premises, reducing international relations to calculations of interest and gap
Severance had limits: Jiji Shinpo kept intelligence and commercial networks toward China—severance as strategic positioning, not total rupture

Counterexample: the method's historical outcome abetted discrimination against and aggression toward China and Korea—once gap judgment slides into value degradation and expansion, a strategic tool becomes a war pretext; users of this method must hold Datsu-A Ron's ending as a permanent warning
modern_applications_zh: 企业转型：剥离拖累升级路径的旧业务线，但须核算品牌与客户的道义与商业成本
个人圈层管理：识别消耗性关系并设定退出触发条件，切割时体面且不诋毁
国际合作评估：以对方发展轨迹对己方的拖累度为变量，设定合作或退出的量化条件
技术路线：放弃被捆绑的旧标准时，诚实标注生态与信任成本
modern_applications_en: Corporate transformation: divest legacy lines that drag the upgrade path, but account for moral and commercial costs to brand and customers
Personal network management: identify draining relationships and set exit triggers; sever with dignity and without defamation
International cooperation: make the partner's drag on your trajectory a variable; set quantitative conditions to cooperate or exit
Technology routes: when abandoning bundled old standards, honestly mark ecosystem and trust costs
